title: Oatmeal Muffins

steps.text: Combine oats and buttermilk in a large mixing bowl and soak for 30 minutes or longer.
Sift flour with salt, soda, and baking powder, set aside.
Add vegetable oil, brown sugar, and beaten egg to oatmeal mixture and blend thoroughly.
Stir in dry ingredients and mix only long enough to moisten.

Bake at 350 degrees for 22-25 minutes or until lightly brown. (Muffins do not rise very high) NIGHT BEFORE: Combine together in a large bowl: oats, buttermilk, oil, brown sugar, and beaten egg. Cover and refrigerate. Prepare sifted dry ingredients and muffin tins. Bring cold batter to room temp before mixing.

notes: Substitute buttermilk with yoghurt (slightly diluted with milk or water). To make (24-28) mini-muffins, reduce cooking time to 20 minutes.
